description: Proxy d3d9.dll skeleton: backend loading (DXVK or system), config, UTC log, crash capture, exe-identity guard with pass-through, runtime patch engine fed by engine_sites, sha-checked install and byte-exact uninstall. No features.

description: Every screen and popup: elements, data and its source, interactions and handlers, states and art, plus everything engine-drawn outside the layout system with a route for each (UI_PIPELINE section 2.1). Seeds ui_elements at status atlas.

description: Phase 2 gate as code: every registry populated and current, and a brief check that fails any brief citing a found path instead of a registry id. Failing-fixture tests.

description: Scenario library and control API: scenarios registry filled (land, siege, naval, historical, campaign saves), fixed sky and weather, camera poses by id, scene/cam/shot/order/pause/speed/reset commands with built-in settle and checked results, frame-time and memory capture, then the acceptance run passing 20 times in a row (phase 1 gate).
title: Scenario library, control API, acceptance gate

description: Audit napoleon-remastered and warscape-core for every prose rule a machine can check or perform; turn each into a gate, schema rule, default or verb with a failing-fixture test; ledger in jobs/J5/rules.md; core-side fixes as a warscape-core PR.

description: Catalogue the shader set and capture frame anatomy in the scenario library: render targets, the shadow pass, what draws blob shadows and why, matrix registers. Facts into engine_facts with run ids; inputs for the shadow and distance work.
